description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability and Decoction Module trigger.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Aethergeode Miner trigger, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.
